elements.title: Efficiency and Resource Analysis

figure.caption: Efficiency comparison of adaptation methods across parameters, latency, and memory

bullets: Client-side: 34x-48x fewer parameters and 50% less memory than full fine-tuning
Near-optimal latency: Only 4% overhead compared to simple linear probing
Server-side bottlenecks: 136s inference per sample and 2.8x FHE data expansion

builds.audio_segment: BlindFed is highly efficient for clients,
requiring up to 48 times fewer parameters and half the memory of full fine-tuning.
Latency is nearly identical to linear probing, with only a 4 percent overhead.
However, server-side encrypted inference remains a bottleneck, taking 136 seconds per sample with a 2.8-times data expansion due to homomorphic encryption.
